title: Senior Enterprise Systems Developer - Procurement Systems
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Senior Enterprise Systems Developer - Procurement Systems Location: Austin, TX About the Role At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. To achieve this, our internal operations must run seamlessly, securely, and efficiently. We are seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking Senior Enterprise Systems Developer to join our Enterprise Systems team with a dedicated focus on our Procurement and Spend Management ecosystem. In this role, you will be the primary technical owner for our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) applications. Your core tech stack will include Zip (Intake/Orchestration), Ironclad, Oracle Fusion Cloud (Procurement), and managing the transition out of Coupa . Your primary customer will be the Procurement Organization, and you will partner closely with them to optimize the way Cloudflare sources, contracts, and purchases at scale. If you are a builder at heart who enjoys solving complex supply chain and procurement workflow challenges, leveraging AI and automation, and designing seamless enterprise integrations, this role is for you. What You'll Do Application Administration & Environment Management Serve as the primary subject-matter expert and developer for Cloudflare’s Procurement technology stack (Zip, Ironclad, Oracle Procurement, Coupa). Manage user provisioning, complex role-based access control (RBAC), and security settings specific to purchasing limits and contract approvals. Manage application environments (e.g., Production vs. Sandbox/Demo), ensuring alignment across all environments from both a data and release perspective. Monitor ongoing application performance and reliability, managing incident workflows to ensure ticket SLAs for the Procurement organization are consistently met. Provide Tier 3 support and end-user enablement, serving as the ultimate technical escalation point for procurement system issues. System Development, Integrations & AI Initiatives Act as the Subject-Matter Expert for integrations across the procurement lifecycle. Ensure the seamless flow of data (e.g., syncing vendor intake data from Zip, passing contract metadata from Ironclad to Oracle Fusion, and managing purchase order syncs). Design, build, and deploy custom system enhancements, automated workflows, template generation, and API integrations between our procurement platforms and core ERP. Lead the evaluation, implementation, and governance of native AI features within the P2P stack (e.g., Ironclad AI for contract analysis and redlining, Zip AI for vendor onboarding/intake routing) to accelerate procurement cycles. Proactively monitor vendors' quarterly updates and product roadmaps (especially for Zip and Ironclad). Lead impact assessments, manage versioning/upgrades, and educate Procurement stakeholders on new functionality and AI opportunities. Process Management & Workflow Design Partner directly with the Procurement organization, Legal, and Finance to deeply understand their operational processes and translate business requirements into sophisticated system solutions. Own the design, configuration, and delivery of complex workflows (e.g., global Procure-to-Pay rules, dynamic intake routing, and automated contract approvals) to eliminate manual bottlenecks. Support the strategic migration and sun-setting of legacy systems (e.g., Coupa), ensuring zero disruption to business continuity during the transition to our modernized stack. Security, Compliance, & Data Governance Partner closely with Internal Audit, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain robust IT General Controls (ITGC) and strict enterprise-wide data governance for spend and vendor data. Spearhead and execute Quarterly Access Reviews (UAR) for all Procurement and CLM applications, ensuring accurate access levels and enforcing strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) within the purchasing cycle. Ensure newly implemented AI features and data-sharing protocols strictly adhere to SOX compliance, vendor risk policies, and maintain audit readiness for all financial and contract records. Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical procurement systems. What We're Looking For Experience: Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, Supply Chain, or a related field. 5-7+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise systems development and administration, with a strong focus on Procurement
